greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Makube nani uxolo nothando lukaThixo uBawo, nenceba yeNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso ohlala unamathele engqondweni yam xa ndicinga ngoBenjamin Vo. Hayi indiza ebaleka esibhakabhakeni, hayi ikhompyutha ayeyikodileyo, kodwa umzuzu othi cwaka ekhitshini. Khumbula umfanekiso kaBen ehlezi phantsi, enxibe iibhulukhwe zakhe eziluhlaza, ephethe isilawuli somdlalo, amehlo akhe ecinga nzulu ngento ethile ebalulekileyo. Kwakukho ukuzola okumangalisayo kulo mfana. Wayengumfana owayebona ihlabathi ngenjongo, owayefuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu ukuya kwindlela yokwakha 'con chim airlines' yakhe—kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encane eyayiqonda ukuba uthando luyinto yokwenziwa, hayi yokuthethwa nje.

Namhlanje, kulo Mkhosi woMnqamlezo oNgcwele, iLizwi likaThixo lisibuyisela emva kwixesha, kwintlango apho abantu bakaSirayeli babephulukene nethemba. Bathi kuMoses, 'Kutheni usizisile apha ukuba sife?' Babesele bediniwe, bediniwe kukuhamba, bediniwe kukutya okufanayo. Bahlaba ikhwelo lokukhalaza. Kwaye uThixo, ngendlela emangalisayo, wathi kuMoses, 'Yenza inyoka yobhedu, uyiphakamise emthini.' Lowo wayeyijongile, wayephila. Lo mfanekiso ubonakala ungaqhelekanga kuthi namhlanje, kodwa uYesu usicacisela wonke umyalezo kwiVangeli: 'Njengokuba uMoses wayiphakamisayo inyoka entlango, kananjalo uNyana woMntu umele aphakanyiswe.'

Masime kancane apha. Kutheni uMnqamlezo? Kutheni uYesu kufuneka aphakanyiswe? UMnqamlezo awungomfanekiso wokufa kuphela; ngumfanekiso wothando olungazigcineliyo nto. UYesu, 'nangona wayekwimo kaThixo,' akazange azibambe loo nto, kodwa wazithoba. Waba ngumkhonzi. Wathatha intlungu yethu, wathatha ukoyika kwethu, wathatha nokufa kwethu, wazibeka phezu komnqamlezo. UMnqamlezo uthi kuwe namhlanje: 'Andikushiyi wedwa.'

Alan noThao, iinyanga ezintathu zidlulile ukususela oko uBen wagodukayo. Ndiyazi ukuba usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazi ukuba usizi lufana nomthwalo onzima ongena ngaphakathi kwindlu yakho ngaphandle kokungqongqoza. Niyazibuza, 'Kutheni uBen? Kutheni umfana onentliziyo elungaka, owayenomdla wokunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam ngemali yakhe, kufuneka ahambe?' Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule amazwi am: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayekuthanda kakhulu, kwaye uthando lwakhe lwalumsulwa njengaloo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe egameni lakhe eCà Mau. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo.

UYesu, xa wayebuzwa malunga nendoda eyayizalwe iyimfama, wathi akukho mntu wonayo. Ubomi buhamba ngeendlela esingazaziyo. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayakha isiseko sayo edwaleni. Ukholo lwakhe, ububele bakhe, uthando lwakhe—konke oku kwakuyisiseko esomeleleyo. Xa isiphango sezifo size, loo ndlu ayizange iwe. UBen usekhululekile ngoku. Akasabandezeleki. Usebanquet yasezulwini, ecaleni kukaSaint Carlo Acutis, owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Namhlanje, xa ubona umnqamlezo, ungaboni nje intlungu. Bona uthando. Bona uYesu owaphakanyiswa ukuze akutsalele kuye. UBen, ngoku, ungowalapho uYesu akhoyo. UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele yeAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumulweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani usikelelo lukaThixo uSomandla, uYise, uNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hamba ngokuthula, uthando lwakhe luhlale nani.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Ngenxa yokudinwa kukuhamba, abantu bakhalaza kuThixo nakuMoses: 'Kutheni nisizisile apha eYiputa ukuba sife kule ntlango, apho kungekho kutya namanzi? Siyakunyanya oku kutya okubi!' Ngenxa yoko, iNkosi yathumela iinyoka ezinobuhlungu phakathi kwabantu, zibaluma kwaye baninzi abafa. Abantu beza kuMoses bathi, 'Sonile ngokukhalazela iNkosi nakuwe. Thandaza kuyo ukuba isisuse ezi nyoka.' UMoses wathandaza, kwaye iNkosi yathi kuye, 'Yenza inyoka, uyiphakamise emthini; kwaye nabani na olunywe yinyoka oya kuyijonga, uya kuphila.' UMoses wenza inyoka yobhedu, wayiphakamisa emthini, kwaye nabani na owayejonga kule nyoka yobhedu emva kokulunywa, wayephila.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: UYesu Kristu, nangona wayekwimo kaThixo, akazange azibambe loo nto njengento yokubanjwa. Kunoko, wazithoba, wathatha imo yomkhonzi, weza efana nomntu; kwaye efumaneka enjengomntu, wazithoba, waba luthobelo kude kube sekufeni, nokufa kumnqamlezo. Ngenxa yoko, uThixo wamphakamisa kakhulu, wamnika igama elingaphezu kwawo onke amagama, ukuze egameni likaYesu onke amadolo aguqe, kwasezulwini, nasemhlabeni, nasezantsi komhlaba, kwaye lonke ulwimi luvume ukuba uYesu Kristu uyiNkosi, kuzuko lukaThixo uBawo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kuNikodemo: 'Akukho mntu unyukele ezulwini, ngaphandle kwalowo wehla evela ezulwini, uNyana woMntu. Kwaye njengokuba uMoses wayiphakamisayo inyoka entlango, kananjalo uNyana woMntu umele aphakanyiswe, ukuze wonke umntu okholwayo kuye abe nobomi obungunaphakade. Kuba uThixo walithanda kangaka ihlabathi, wada wanikela ngoNyana wakhe okuphela kwamzeleyo, ukuze wonke umntu okholwayo kuye angatshabalali, kodwa abe nobomi obungunaphakade. Kuba uThixo akazange amthume uNyana wakhe ehlabathini ukuba aligwebe ihlabathi, kodwa ukuze ihlabathi lisindiswe ngaye.'

day: Feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school
